== English Endor comparison ==
The PC Appendix A replacement and full D-E1 face say targeted in place of deployed. Decipher's January 2002 Supplement p. 3 separately limits targeting as Luke to a Daughter first deployed from Reserve Deck with the Objective. The known 2010 PC announcement concerns the Virtual Daughter. The current Endor foil remains a separate physical publication.
